judgment: The hands are washed, but the offering is not yet made —
there is trust, in grave reverence.
image: Wind moves over the earth: Looking.
So the early kings went round the regions,
looked at the people, and set up teaching.
lines: For the small person: no harm.
But for the noble one: shame.
It is good for a woman to hold firm.
I look at my own life:
He looks at the light of the state.
It is good for him to be a guest of the king.
I look at my own life.

notes.name_en: 觀 is looking and being looked up at; plain 'Looking', not Wilhelm's 'Contemplation'.
notes.judgment: 盥 ritual hand-washing before the offering (薦) is presented; 顒若 grave reverence.
